subject: Accusations leave a bad taste in my mouth...
author: ZombieTron
body:
I really don't like all the forum accusations of cheating, especially when a lot of it seems to just be about racers who choose to race only with their friends, and especially when it's about racing in Burnout Paradise, which isn't a serious racing game.

For me, and most people who play on Xbox 360, Burnout Paradise isn't a racing game, there are never many ranked race rooms open (at least the last few times I checked). I only ever play in friends rooms, mostly because when I started playing BP the voice comms on Xbox 360 didn't work so joining random rooms which were silent kinda defeated the point of playing online.

We also hardly ever race, we occassionally throw a race in to mix it up, but otherwise we just mess about or do challenges or stunt runs with the odd marked man thrown in for good measure.

Racing on Paradise is rubbish! Maybe I say that because I am rubbish at it, or just because I really don't like open world racing, or maybe it really is rubbish. Either way I really don't understand why PS3 players take it so seriously and get so angry with so-called cheaters. It is only a video game, and it's not even a serious racing video game.

I think everyone just needs to chill and play the game their way, with so many players online it is really easy to avoid players that you don't like.
